audience: clubs and membership organizations that run their members in Members.dev

useCases.title: Look up a member
useCases.text: Find a member by id or external id and read the subscriptions of that person.

useCases.title: Review invoices and payments
useCases.text: List the invoices, the payments and the credit notes of a period.

useCases.title: Check event bookings
useCases.text: List the events and the bookings and guests of one event.

useCases.title: Check the benefits of a membership
useCases.text: List the benefits and the grants that members received.

useCases.title: Add or correct a member
useCases.text: Create a new member, or update the details of an existing one.
